title: 2014 Portuguese Socialist Party prime ministerial primary
summary: On 28 September 2014 the Socialists held the first open primary in Portuguese politics — a ballot any voter could register for, not only party members — to choose the candidate for prime minister at the coming election. António Costa, then mayor of Lisbon, beat the incumbent secretary-general António José Seguro by about sixty-eight per cent to thirty-two, and took the leadership of the party with the candidacy. It is in the atlas because the change of leader is what changed the answer: Costa read the 2015 result as an arithmetic of the chamber rather than a ranking of lists, and the government of November 2015 followed from that reading.

actors.role: won it and took the leadership
